automations.name: [factory:intake]
automations.prompt: Save the trigger payload (the <trigger_event> JSON) to a file. Run `uv run factory/gate.py check --node intake --event <file>`; on exit 10 stop and report why. Otherwise read `role_file` and every skill it lists, and do the role's work. Then run `uv run factory/gate.py apply --node intake --event <file> --outcome <outcome> --payload <file>` with the outcome name of the node. The payload file is a JSON object with `ticket` (from the event) plus every field the outcome's effects name (for example `tier`, `reason`).
